model: Interchange Comm Control Module MX5-R2 (Standard IO mode)
equipment_type: Remote I/O module (engine / pump controller expansion)
applies_to: FW Murphy MX5-R2 modules with date code S8 or later running the Standard IO application (default); pulse registers need firmware 4.4.10111 / date code U10 or later.
summary: The MX5-R2 is FW Murphy's I/O and communications expansion module for Centurion controllers, with 24 digital inputs, 10 analog inputs, a magnetic pickup, 16 digital outputs and 4 analog outputs. In Standard IO mode it is a Modbus RTU server on two RS-485 ports and RS-232 and a Modbus TCP server on Ethernet, all using one holding-register table. This map covers the whole published table.

addressing.note: Registers are printed in 6-digit Modicon form (400001 = holding register 1). Wire address = number - 400001, e.g. digital inputs 400021 = address 20 and IP address 465197 = address 65196.

firmware: Date code S8 or later; pulse engine registers 4.4.10111 / date code U10 or later

source.title: Interchange Comm Control Module MX5-R2 Series Operations Manual
source.pages: pp. 4-5 (communications), pp. 6-10 (holding register table), pp. 10-12 (register descriptions)

notes: Analog inputs: the register notes call them signed 16-bit counts, but the table gives full scale as 32768 = 5 V or 25 mA while the text says 32767 = 24 mA (4 mA = 5243, 20 mA = 26214). They are left as raw INT16 counts; calibrate against the stated 4-20 mA counts.
The 400090-400097 polarity rows reuse the DI1-DI8 byte labels in the table; this map labels them by the register's channel pair (DI9-DI24).
Default serial framing: the module answers with 1 stop bit at addresses 1-31 and 2 stop bits at 32-239; parity is not stated.

integration.summary: Poll holding registers 400021-400038 for inputs, write 400061 and 400047-400050 for outputs, and set 400073 plus the comm-failure registers so outputs go to a safe state if the client stops polling.
integration.enable: Standard IO mode is the default (COP LED code 4,2). To reload it: power up with DIP 5-8 closed and DIP 2 open, 1/3/4 closed. DIP 5-8 closed with 1-4 closed loads factory defaults (baud, Ethernet, channel configuration).
integration.watchdog: Register 400073 sets a communication timeout in seconds; when no client talks on any port for that time, outputs go to the states in 400064 and 400069-400072. Pulse mode is also cancelled on comm loss.
quirks: Supported functions: 03, 06 and 16 only; invalid addresses return an exception.
Polarity registers pack two inputs: high byte = odd channel, low byte = even channel.
The firmware checksum is split MSW (400009) then LSW (400010).
setup: RS-485: A (+) on terminals 61/62, B (-) on 80/81; twisted shielded pair, 120 ohm.
Serial default 9600 baud, up to 115.2k via 400085; set the RTU client timeout to at least 400 ms.
gotchas: In Rockwell IO mode the Ethernet ports speak EtherNet/IP (CIP) only, not Modbus TCP.
DIP switches 5-8 double as address switches; the special functions only act when they are closed at power-up.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
